description:
LG Ad Solutions

LG Ad Solutions is a global leader in connected TV (CTV) and cross-screen advertising. We pride ourselves on delivering state-of-the-art advertising solutions that integrate seamlessly with today's ever-evolving digital media landscape.

The Opportunity

LG Ad Solutions is looking for an experienced, hands-on marketer to help build and deliver integrated marketing and communications programs.

This role requires someone who can get deep into our business, understanding our products, services, customers, and the CTV advertising industry, and use that knowledge to make sound marketing decisions.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Marketing & Communications, you'll have the opportunity to apply your experience and judgment to develop new marketing programs and help establish how they are planned and delivered, within the framework of our global marketing strategy.

Collaboration is fundamental to how we operate and central to this role. You'll work across functions and regional markets, building strong relationships, respecting each team's expertise, and finding complementary ways to support shared business priorities. You'll be equally comfortable doing the work yourself, managing complex projects, and bringing people together to get things done.

Responsibilities

Integrated Marketing Programs

  • Develop and deliver marketing programs aligned with our global positioning, narrative, and business priorities, bringing experience-informed ideas and establishing practical, repeatable approaches.

  • Work across the business to understand commercial priorities, products, partnerships, research, and events, identifying opportunities to turn them into relevant marketing programs.

  • Partner with regional marketing colleagues to support their priorities, ensure messaging consistency with global strategy and positioning, and coordinate shared activity, with regional teams retaining ownership of local execution.

Organic Social, Editorial Planning & Communications

  • Own day-to-day organic social, including content planning, writing, creative coordination, approvals, and publishing, ensuring the channel advances our company narrative, strengthens our market positioning, and supports broader marketing and commercial objectives.

  • Own the global editorial and communications calendar, connecting company-wide priorities, announcements, and initiatives with planned marketing activity across functions and markets.

  • Work with regional colleagues to maintain visibility into local plans, ensure alignment with our global narrative and positioning, and identify opportunities to coordinate activity.

  • Execute marketing communications across relevant channels, working from established messaging and content developed with leadership, internal subject-matter experts, and agency partners.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Delivery

  • Manage multiple workstreams, timelines, dependencies, and approvals through Asana, ensuring clear ownership and follow-through.

  • Coordinate with marketing and PR agencies, and other internal and external partners to connect their work with broader marketing and communications activity.

  • Bring the right people and resources together, make practical decisions, and keep programs moving from idea through delivery.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in B2B marketing, integrated marketing, marketing communications, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated success building and delivering marketing programs, including introducing new initiatives and improving existing approaches.

  • Intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated ability to quickly understand complex businesses, products, and industries, and apply that knowledge to marketing decisions. Experience in CTV or streaming advertising is a welcome plus, but not a requirement.

  • Exceptional organizational skills, advanced Asana experience, and proven success managing complex editorial calendars and competing priorities.

  • Strong understanding of marketing communications and how to use different channels effectively, with sound editorial judgment and demonstrated writing ability. Writing samples from any relevant professional work are welcome.

  • Excellent collaboration skills, with experience navigating matrixed organizations, senior stakeholders, and external partners.

  • Demonstrated enthusiasm for and practical experience using AI to improve marketing workflows, with a strong understanding of where it adds value, how to use it effectively, and when human judgment is essential.

What Makes You Successful

  • You're exceptionally organized. You manage competing priorities without things falling through the cracks, creating order without bureaucracy.

  • You're a hands-on marketer. You bring ideas grounded in experience, know where to start, and enjoy getting the work done.

  • You have good judgment. You ask smart questions, challenge assumptions constructively, recognize priorities, and know when a straightforward solution is the right one. You know how to balance strategic thinking with a bias for action.

  • You're resourceful and collaborative. You build productive relationships, draw on the expertise of others, and take ownership of moving work forward.

LG Ad Solutions provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@lgads.tv to let us know the nature of your request.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Tier 1* (San Francisco Bay Area, New York City Tri-State Area, Los Angeles Metro Area, and Seattle Metro Area)$185,000 - $264,000/year

  • Tier 2* (all other U.S. Locations outside of Tier 1) $162,000 – $231,000/yr

  • Offers Bonus

  • Benefits & Perks: 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents. Company-paid life and AD&D, STD and LTD insurance, plus optional supplemental coverage. 401(k) with company match. Flexible Time Off (FTO). Paid parental leave.
